name: After recital H
title: REPORT on a European Parliament recommendation to the Council, the Commission and the Vice-President of the Commission / High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy concerning EU-China political relations
part_text: Ha. whereas climate change, biodiversity loss and global health risks constitute systemic, borderless threats that neither the EU nor China can address unilaterally, and that require sustained multilateral cooperation and shared scientific and technological effort; whereas enhanced EU-China cooperation in these fields, including through existing dialogue mechanisms such as the High-Level Environment and Climate Dialogue and joint research initiatives under Horizon Europe, is indispensable to accelerating progress towards achieving the objectives of the Paris Agreement, the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework and the UN 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development;
